title: This Bird Circled the Whole Planet in 46 Days
subject: grey-headed albatross

scenes.text: A bird flew around the whole planet in 46 days.
Nobody told it to. Scientists just tracked it with a tag.
It was a grey-headed albatross, riding the winds of the Southern Ocean.
It barely flaps. It swoops through faster and slower layers of air to gain speed.
And a locking mechanism in its shoulder holds the wings outstretched, so it spends little energy.
Out of the tracked birds, over half made a full lap of the planet.

description:
A grey-headed albatross flew all the way around the planet in just 46 days.
Tracking tags showed it riding the Southern Ocean winds, and over half of the tracked birds made a full lap.
Would you have guessed a bird could do it?
first_comment: One tracked bird circled the globe three times in 18 months. Which animal should we track next?
